verdict.rationale: Metorial documents first-party adapters for the Vercel AI SDK (@metorial/ai-sdk, its recommended TypeScript path), the OpenAI SDK, Anthropic, Google Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers, with an adapter-based connect API shown in code. The pack does not document LangChain or CrewAI adapters, so not every framework the story names is covered. Missing for 10: documented LangChain adapter, documented CrewAI adapter, independent or hands-on corroboration of the adapters working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters

citations.quote: The Vercel AI SDK integration (`@metorial/ai-sdk`) is the recommended way to use Metorial in TypeScript applications.
The OpenAI provider integration lets you use Metorial's MCP tools with OpenAI's GPT models, including GPT-4 and GPT-3.5.
The Anthropic provider integration lets you use Metorial's MCP tools with Claude models (Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku).
